title: Count the intersection of the X102 and Y71 cones
body:
## Summary
- The dimension-5 transfer leaves X102 on 1,725 edges. Y71 has 12 dimension-8 writers, through arrival slots 142 and 143.
- Expanding through dimensions 8, 7 and 6 leaves 12, then 22, then 37 backward edges. Their intersection with the 1,725 forward edges is empty.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. The other required pairs are not accumulated. The receipt includes a SHA-256 digest of the 37 backward edge indices.
